title: Department of Energy holds both UFO secrets and the Human Genome Project

tellings.quote: And while the Department of Energy per the UFO nuclear connection likely holds a lot of secrets when it comes to unidentified flying objects and their reverse engineering, they also conducted the human genome project.

plain: The US Department of Energy, the agency that runs the country's nuclear weapons labs, likely holds many secrets about UFOs and attempts to copy their technology, and it also ran the Human Genome Project, the 1990s effort to map all human genes. Jesse Michels puts these two together himself, pointing to a link between UFOs and nuclear sites, in a 2025 episode about medical experiments with a pharmacy businessman named Brigham Buhler. If true, it would mean one agency sits on both UFO secrets and humanity's genetic blueprint.
